evidence.observation: T701 reads 446.1 °C while adjacent T702 and T703 read 75.5 and 82.0 °C; the extreme discrepancy persists from the first event (443.3 versus 77.7 and 81.1 °C).
Temperatures have fallen from 122.9, 118.2 and 124.9 °C at the first event to 78.5, 74.0 and 86.6 °C, despite persistently high T701.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.1 and 0.7 L/h, inconsistent with FYI702=5.9 if it represents the measured reflux/distillate ratio; flows have remained low throughout.
System pressure remains near 800 mbar, with pressure differences near 1 and 3 mbar; no rising-pressure signature identifies a blockage or leak.
